newsitem.title: USA: US stock fund flows ebb in 2-day period -- survey.
newsitem.headline: US stock fund flows ebb in 2-day period -- survey.

text.p: U.S. stock mutual funds posted a slight decline in cash inflows to $647 million for the two-day period ending December 30, versus $649 million for the prior three-day period, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
According to the fund tracker, international funds jumped to inflows of $73 million for the two-day period versus outflows of $9 million for the three-day period.

Growth funds fell to inflows of $241 million versus inflows of $319 million, growth and income funds rose to inflows of $332 million versus inflows of $263 million, and global funds had inflows of $43 million versus outflows of $16 million, according to Trim Tabs.

Bond funds posted had outflows of $69 million versus inflows of $334 million. Flexible/balanced/mixed funds had outflows of $11 million versus inflows of $107 million. Muni funds had outflows of $3 million versus inflows of $208 million, and corporate/income/global funds had outflows of $29 million versus inflows of $22 million.
